_comment: Enable/disable sources. exclude_agencies removes adverts from recruitment agencies (list in config/agencies.json); career_sites reads employers' own careers pages (config/employers.json); channel says how candidates apply: career_site, official (NHS/universities/schools/government boards) or aggregator. Keyed sources read credentials from environment variables (GitHub Actions secrets). RSS feeds: add any RSS/Atom job feed; 'country' is ISO 3166 alpha-2.

public_sector_employers._note: Civil Service departments and councils searched by name on Reed (config/public_sector_employers.json). Civil Service Jobs itself has no public feed and is not scraped.

jobtech_sweden._note: Platsbanken (Swedish Public Employment Service) open API: no key needed. Adverts include the employer's named contacts.

jobs_ac_uk._note: jobs.ac.uk search (UK and overseas universities). Its RSS feeds were withdrawn; adverts are read from their schema.org JobPosting data.

the_unijobs._note: Times Higher Education unijobs RSS (universities worldwide); each listing page is read for the full advert.

publicjobs_ie._note: publicjobs.ie job board (publicjobs.tal.net): Irish civil service, local authorities, state boards and other public bodies. Labelled ie_public_sector (EEA/UK/Swiss citizens or Stamp 4/5).

local_government_ie._note: localgovernmentjobs.ie: the newest Irish council vacancies, with salary scales.

education_posts_ie._note: educationposts.ie: Irish school, college and further-education posts (second level, primary, third level, other). No posting date in the listing.

eu_careers._note: eu-careers.europa.eu: vacancies at EU institutions and agencies, with the agency's application link. Labelled eu_institution (EU citizenship normally required).

rss._note: Add any RSS/Atom job feed here, e.g. a council or university vacancy feed, as {"name": "Hull City Council", "url": "<feed url>", "employer": "Hull City Council", "location": "Hull"}. Many councils publish one on their jobs page (look for an RSS or Atom link); there is no national feed. The jobs.ac.uk and EURAXESS RSS addresses used before were withdrawn (404) and are now read by their own connectors.
